body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by a close-range Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Gain +1 Defense against the triggering Action. You may spend 1 Combo to increase this bonus by 1.

surges.html: Increase one Defense bonus from this card by 1.
If you spend Combo while resolving this card, reduce that Combo cost by 1, minimum 0. This Surge may be used only once.
